start.dialog: A Yeti has been raiding the outlying villages! Not killing, but stealing food and livestock. The hunters want it dead, but I think it's just hungry and desperate. Track it, but try not to kill it—drive it back to the high peaks where it belongs!
start.objective: Track the Yeti to its lair in the Frozen Peaks

progress.dialog: You found it—a massive female, nursing cubs! She's only stealing to feed them! Scare her off without harming the cubs! Use loud noises, fire, show of strength—but don't hurt her!
progress.objective: Drive the Yeti family back to the high peaks without harming them

complete.dialog: They've returned to the peaks! The villages are safe, the Yetis are alive! True harmony with nature! The village elders gift you this Yeti Fur Cloak—warm as a furnace, soft as silk!

party_comments.kade: I didn't want to hurt her anyway. She was just being a mom!
party_comments.twist: The cubs were adorable. I nearly kept one as a pet.
party_comments.nix7: Wildlife relocation: successful. Ecological balance: maintained.
